newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels files for 5.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels files for 5.5 mln shares.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 5.5 million common shares.
Of the total, 4,675,000 common shares are being offered in the United States and Canada, while 825,000 common shares will be sold in the international market, the filing said.
The company has granted U.S. and international underwriters 30-day over-allotment options of up to 701,250 additional common shares and 123,750 additional common shares respectively, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Montgomery Securities, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Smith Barney Inc and Credit Lyonnais Securities (USA) Inc.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 36,139,296 common, the filing said.
Proceeds will be used to finance pending hotel acquisitions, to repay existing indebtedness, to finance other possible acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
Interstate, of Pittsburgh, Pa., is an independent hotel management company and performs related services for its 161 hotels.
